calls.title: Anton Bogdanov and Jake Heier
calls.summary:
# MEDDICC Sales Call Summary

Call on [date] with Anton Bogdanov (DevOps Engineer, Coda), Jake Heier (Account Executive, Growthbook), and Logan Bates (Solutions Engineer, Growthbook).

## Attendees and Titles
Anton Bogdanov serves as DevOps Engineer at Coda with three years tenure, leading the technical evaluation. His manager will confirm technical success, alongside a principal engineer providing additional oversight. The VP of Finance holds budget authority for financial decisions post-POC.

## Quantifiable Outcomes and Metrics
Anton established three key performance metrics for the proof of concept: governance functionality testing (SSO, role-based access controls, approval workflows) to verify speed and expected performance; multi-tenant targeting validation using workspace ID attributes to ensure proper granularity; and reliability testing through simulated downtime scenarios to confirm caching and proxy layers maintain system stability without undesirable feature toggle fallbacks to default values. Success criteria specifically target zero toggle flips during outages and confirmed failover functionality.

## Budget Authority Signals
The VP of Finance holds final approval authority for financial decisions. Anton indicated potential for "a decent amount of users" in full rollout, suggesting meaningful budget consideration. The decision-making structure includes technical validation (Anton and manager) followed by financial approval, indicating established budget review processes.

## Technical Requirements and Architecture
Anton targets self-hosted deployment over cloud, prioritizing control and reliability. Technical requirements include MongoDB as the primary external dependency, with Kubernetes deployment via Helm chart as the preferred infrastructure approach. Growthbook integrates with BigQuery and APIs. The environment operates on GCP infrastructure. Logan emphasized that self-hosted eliminates automatic updates, requiring manual maintenance, while cloud deployment provides automatic updates and doesn't expose PII concerns given Growthbook's data warehouse query model rather than data storage approach.

## Decision Process and Timeline
The POC will launch immediately with Anton leading testing, involving one to two additional engineering team members. A research engineer currently conducting AB testing will participate in experimentation validation. Full rollout would establish read-write access for portions of engineering, account executives, and sales engineers, with read-only access for remaining engineering staff and upper management. Technical success requires Anton and manager sign-off, principal engineer review, and subsequent VP of Finance approval.

## Specific Pain Points
Anton emphasized governance requirements (SSO, RBAC, approval flows), multi-tenant targeting precision, and reliability during infrastructure failures. The concern about fallback behavior during outages indicates current system fragility when feature flag services degrade.

## Champion Signals
Anton demonstrated strong engagement, confirming alignment with previously discussed requirements and actively asking technical architecture questions. His proactive inquiry about self-hosted versus cloud deployment and Kubernetes implementation indicates serious technical evaluation commitment.

## Competitors Mentioned
Coda competes against Code Rabbit and Cryptile with AI code review offerings.

## Next Steps
Logan will send Kubernetes Helm chart documentation and deployment links for GCP infrastructure. Technical setup discussion will proceed with Anton and Logan to initiate POC environment configuration.
